metadata.label: Centrifugal Propellant Pump
metadata.description: Liquid propellant centrifugal turbopump stage with affinity-law head/torque characteristics.

parameters.description: Design pump head at rated speed
Zero-flow shutoff head to design head ratio

metadata.label: Drive Gas Turbine
metadata.description: Axial impulse/reaction drive gas turbine expanding hot gas to power the turbopump shaft.
metadata.provenance: Sutton & Biblarz (9th ed.) Ch. 10; NASA SP-8110 Liquid Rocket Engine Turbines

parameters.description: Design turbine gas mass flow rate
Drive gas ratio of specific heats

metadata.label: Cavitating Axial Inducer
metadata.description: Low-NPSH axial-flow inducer boosting inlet pressure upstream of the main impeller.
metadata.provenance: NASA SP-8052 Liquid Rocket Engine Turbopump Inducers; Huzel & Huang Ch. 6

metadata.label: Turbopump Rotor Shaft
metadata.description: Common rotating mechanical shaft integrating net turbine-minus-pump torque.

parameters.description: Polar moment of inertia of rotating assembly
Bearing and seal viscous friction torque

metadata.label: Turbopump Reduction Gearbox
metadata.description: Mechanical speed reduction gear train coupling high-speed turbine to low-speed pump.
metadata.provenance: Huzel & Huang Ch. 6; NASA SP-8100 Liquid Rocket Engine Turbopump Gears

metadata.label: Main Combustion Chamber
metadata.description: Transient rocket combustion chamber with c-star throat choking and ideal-gas pressure dynamics.

parameters.description: Combustion gas specific gas constant R
Combustion gas ratio of specific heats

metadata.label: Staged-Combustion Preburner
metadata.description: High-pressure fuel-rich or oxidizer-rich preburner generating turbine drive gas.
metadata.provenance: Huzel & Huang Ch. 4; NASA SP-1252 / SSME Staged-Combustion Preburner Model

metadata.label: Open-Cycle Gas Generator
metadata.description: Open-cycle propellant gas generator supplying low-temperature turbine drive gas.
metadata.provenance: Sutton & Biblarz (9th ed.) Ch. 10; Huzel & Huang Ch. 7

metadata.label: Convergent-Divergent Nozzle
metadata.description: Isentropic choked supersonic rocket nozzle computing mdot = Pc*At/c*, Cf, thrust, and Isp.

metadata.label: Propellant Main Injector
metadata.description: Coaxial/impinging injector face hydraulic resistance and pressure drop stiffness model.

parameters.description: Effective discharge coefficient times orifice area

metadata.label: Augmented Spark / Torch Igniter
metadata.description: Hypergolic or torch igniter providing startup thermal power and pilot mass flow.

parameters.description: Nominal igniter pilot mass flow rate

metadata.label: Propellant Feedline / Pipe
metadata.description: 1-D propellant duct with fluid inertance (L/A) and Darcy-Weisbach friction loss.

metadata.label: Fluid Capacitance Volume
metadata.description: Lumped fluid capacitance manifold integrating net mass inflow via bulk modulus.

metadata.label: Propellant Control Valve
metadata.description: Actuated propellant control valve with first-order stroke lag and CdA/Cv flow law.

metadata.label: Fixed Trim Orifice / Venturi
metadata.description: Sharp-edged calibration orifice or cavitating venturi for steady hydraulic balancing.

metadata.label: Non-Return Check Valve
metadata.description: One-way propellant check valve with cracking pressure threshold preventing backflow.
metadata.provenance: NASA SP-8097 Liquid Rocket Valve Components

metadata.label: Dome-Loaded Pressure Regulator
metadata.description: Closed-loop pneumatic/hydraulic pressure regulator modulating flow to maintain outlet setpoint.

metadata.label: Flow Splitter Manifold
metadata.description: Hydraulic tee splitting an inlet stream into primary and secondary branches.

metadata.label: Flow Mixer / Combiner

metadata.label: Propellant Heat Exchanger

metadata.label: Regenerative Cooling Jacket
